title: J5: MIMI topicId longer than 191 octets
description: JMAP ids cap at 255 bytes, so base64url of a MIMI topicId (up to 4096 octets) may not fit. Recommended: refuse or hash topicIds over 191 octets (choose one). PENDING Mark (from the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18); decide when mimid-1wgh.13 is planned.
notes:
DECIDED: a MIMI topicId of 192-4096 octets (base64url > 255, base L642) is dropped: deliver the message without topicId/subject. Over 4096 octets: reject as hostile (content-09). Empty MIMI topicId maps to absent (content-09: no grouping). Draft gap noted on .12.1.
REVISED by Mark 2026-10-18: topicId maps as UTF-8 in both directions instead of base64url. JMAP topicId = the MIMI topicId bytes as UTF-8; outbound MIMI topicId = the UTF-8 of the JMAP string. A MIMI topicId that isn't valid UTF-8 or exceeds 255 bytes is not mapped (deliver the message without topicId/subject); empty maps to absent; over 4096 octets rejected as hostile (content-09). The 191-octet limit goes away. Draft change to mimi-00 L119 handed to crate-jmap-50.
